root.label: Nepal Himlung avalanche kills expedition workers

events.label: Nepal Himlung avalanche kills expedition workers

slots.name: death toll
slots.sentence: A Himalayan avalanche killed at least 15 expedition workers, as rescuers continued efforts to recover bodies from a mountain camp in central Nepal.

slots.name: rescue team size
slots.sentence: A team of eleven rescuers, including experienced guides, were at the site, digging through more than four metres (14 feet) of snow which had buried tents at the base camp.

slots.name: mountain height
slots.sentence: Rescuers recovered eight more bodies on Thursday from the area of the avalanche that swept through the base camp of the 7,126-metre (23,345-foot) Himlung peak early on Sunday, in one of the worst mountain disasters in recent years.

events.label: Nepal rescuers recover eight Himlung avalanche bodies

slots.name: missing people
slots.sentence: The Nepal National Mountain Guide Association, which is leading the search, said rescuers dug through snow on Mount Himlung to find eight bodies in tents at the base camp, where one person remains missing.

slots.name: recovery status
slots.sentence: “Due to continuing mountain hazards, recovery efforts have been temporarily concluded,” the association said.
